Overview

Norwich is a city in England with a population of 213,000. A fine medieval city in East Anglia, known for its Norman cathedral, cobbled lanes, independent shops, and the Norfolk Broads nearby. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
